headline: Revenue +21% with North America +20% and Greater China +55%; Tapestry lifts FY26 EPS outlook to ~$6.95.
guidance_note: FY26 revenue raised to ~$7.95B from >$7.75B; non-GAAP EPS ~ $6.95 from $6.40-6.45; operating margin ~23%.
key_messages: Revenue +21% reported (+19% cc; pro forma +25%, +23% cc); Coach +31% (+29% cc), Kate Spade -10%.
North America +20%, Europe +21%, Greater China +55% (pro forma cc); management cited strong Gen Z demand.
Core leather goods grew on both higher AUR and units.
Operating margin up 490 bps; EPS +62%; Investor Day targets expected two years early.

consumer.big_ticket: Handbag demand very strong in the US and China.

macro_read: US demand for accessible luxury was very strong in early 2026, with North America up about 20%, a sign that young and middle-to-upper-income shoppers kept spending on fashion.
notes: Growth excludes Stuart Weitzman (sold) and is in constant currency. It is revenue growth, not a like-for-like comp.
EPS consensus null: sources disagree ($1.28 Investing.com vs ~$1.30 TipRanks). Revenue consensus not found.
Shares fell despite the beat (Investing.com cited ~-9.7% intraday); close not confirmed, so null.
Gross margin +80 bps (76.9% vs 76.1%) per one summary; basis (GAAP vs non-GAAP) not confirmed.
GAAP EPS $1.65 vs non-GAAP $1.66. A transcript cited North America +27% (likely Coach North America); release says +20% total.

sources.label: Investing.com Q3 FY26 call transcript summary
